newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo privatises plantation firm at record price.
newsitem.headline: Colombo privatises plantation firm at record price.

text.p: Distilleries Co of Sri Lanka Ltd on Friday bought a 51 percent stake in Balangoda Plantations Ltd being privatised by Colombo at 420.75 million rupees, brokers said.
It was the highest price for a controlling stake in a plantation firm ever sold by the government, which started privatising the sector in the second half of last year.
The previous high for a controlling stake in a plantation firm was 359.55 million rupees recorded on August 23 for Agarapatana Plantations, they said.
